details:
ROOTWISE – NASA-Powered Climate-Adaptive Crop Rotation Intelligence Platform

ROOTWISE is a web platform designed to help farmers plan and compare crop rotations across three growing seasons. It brings together farm details, soil records, previous crop history, environmental data and farmer preferences to suggest suitable crop sequences.

How It Works:
Farmers can add their farm and field details, record soil samples and maintain their crop history. ROOTWISE uses this information along with tested NASA POWER climatology data to explore different crop rotations. It offers three planning strategies: Soil Guardian, Water Saver and Balanced Return, each focusing on different farming priorities.

Key Features:

  • Three-Season Rotation: Compare crop sequences across three growing seasons.
  • Planning Strategies: Choose between soil-focused, water-saving and balanced approaches.
  • Risk Radar: Highlights possible issues such as water stress, repeated crop-family use, seasonal mismatch and missing data.
  • Explainable Recommendations: Shows why a crop sequence is suggested and highlights data limitations.
  • Farm Management: Manage farm, field, soil-sample and crop-history records.

Technology Used:

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, HTML and CSS.
  • Backend & Database: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Supabase Auth, JavaScript Client, PostgreSQL Functions/RPC and Row Level Security (RLS).
  • Development Tools: Node.js, npm, Git, GitHub, VS Code and PowerShell.
  • Deployment: Vercel (intended hosting platform).

NASA Data:
We tested NASA POWER climatology data, including temperature, precipitation, root-zone wetness, surface wetness and solar radiation, to bring environmental information into crop-rotation planning.

What Makes It Different:
Instead of focusing on just the next crop, ROOTWISE looks at how crop choices can affect the following growing seasons. Farmers can compare different strategies and understand the reasons behind the suggested rotations.

Factors Considered:
We considered soil conditions, water requirements, previous crops, crop-family compatibility, seasonal suitability, climate conditions, economic returns and farmer preferences while developing the platform.

Intended Impact:
Through ROOTWISE, we want to help farmers make better-informed crop decisions, plan water use more carefully, maintain soil health and adapt their farming choices to changing environmental conditions.
